app.title: Ginux: A New Kernel Runs Linux Userspace, Made via Human-Directed AI Engineering
app.description: A minimal Linux-compatible kernel engineered by AI, capable of running Linux userspace binaries.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and build kernel image with make
Boot the kernel in QEMU and run a simple hello-world user program
Measure boot time and memory footprint compared to a standard Linux kernel
Run a basic sysbench benchmark inside the kernel to assess syscall latency
